Fresnel.definition: Fresnel[mats_, thetatemp_, assumption_:0] := Module[{wIncLocal, wavLLocal, wavNLLocal, tmpw1Local, tmpw2Local, rmpw1Local, rmpw2Local, rEtemp, tEtemp, m1, m2, m3}, wIncLocal = setwInc[ω0, N[(thetatemp/180)*Pi], Δδ, φ, n0]; extWave[wIncLocal]; If[assumption == 0, wavLLocal = f4L[mats, wIncLocal]; , If[assumption == 1 || assumption == 2, wavLLocal = f4L[mats, wIncLocal, True]; ]]; {rmpw1Local, rmpw2Local} = wavLLocal[[1]]; {tmpw1Local, tmpw2Local} = wavLLocal[[2]]; extWave[rmpw1Local]; extWave[rmpw2Local]; extWave[tmpw1Local]; extWave[tmpw2Local]; rEtemp = (rmpw1Local[A] + rmpw2Local[A])[[1 ;; 2]]; tEtemp = (tmpw1Local[A] + tmpw2Local[A])[[1 ;; 2]]; {thetatemp, rEtemp[[1]]*Conjugate[rEtemp[[1]]], rEtemp[[2]]*Conjugate[rEtemp[[2]]], tEtemp[[1]]*Conjugate[tEtemp[[1]]], tEtemp[[2]]*Conjugate[tEtemp[[2]]]}]

MF.definition: MF[mats_, thetatemp_, assumption_:0] := Module[{wIncLocal, wavLLocal, wavNLLocal, tmpw1Local, tmpw2Local, tEboLocal, tEruiLocal, m1, m2, m3}, wIncLocal = setwInc[ω0, N[(thetatemp/180)*Pi], Δδ, φ, n0]; extWave[wIncLocal]; If[assumption == 0, flagJK = False; flagHH = False; {wavLLocal, wavNLLocal} = f4NL[mats, wIncLocal]; , If[assumption == 1, flagBackward = False; flagStandingWave = False; flagJK = True; flagHH = False; {wavLLocal, wavNLLocal} = f4NL[mats, wIncLocal, True]; , If[assumption == 2, flagBackward = False; flagStandingWave = False; flagJK = False; flagHH = True; {wavLLocal, wavNLLocal} = f4NL[mats, wIncLocal, True]; ]; ]; ]; {tmpw1Local, tmpw2Local} = wavNLLocal[[2]]; extWave[tmpw1Local]; extWave[tmpw2Local]; tEboLocal = (tmpw2Local[A] + tmpw1Local[A])[[1 ;; 2]]; tEruiLocal = {{Cos[ψ], Sin[ψ]}, {-Sin[ψ], Cos[ψ]}} . tEboLocal; {thetatemp, tEruiLocal[[1]]*Conjugate[tEruiLocal[[1]]], tEruiLocal[[2]]*Conjugate[tEruiLocal[[2]]]}]

Attributes[SampleRotate] = {HoldAll}
 
SampleRotate[mats_, thetatemp_, rotatetemp_, rotatesteptemp_, assumption_:0, totalmats_, Δδ_, φtemp_, ψ_] := Module[{wIncLocal, wavLLocal, wavNLLocal, tmpw1Local, tmpw2Local, tEboLocal, tEruiLocal, tEruiLocal1, tEruiLocal2, m1, m2, m3, matstemp, rmpw1Local, rmpw2Local, rEboLocal, rEruiLocal, rEruiLocal1, rEruiLocal2, i}, wIncLocal = setwInc[ω0, N[(thetatemp/180)*Pi], Δδ, φ, n0]; extWave[wIncLocal]; If[rotatetemp != 0, For[i = 2, i <= totalmats + 1, i = i + 1, matstemp = mats[[i]]; If[matstemp[[Key[orientation]]][[1]] == 1, matstemp[[Key[orientation]]][[1]] = 2]; matstemp[[Key[orientation]]][[3]][[1]] = Chop[N[{{Cos[rotatesteptemp*Degree], -Sin[rotatesteptemp*Degree], 0}, {Sin[rotatesteptemp*Degree], Cos[rotatesteptemp*Degree], 0}, {0, 0, 1}} . matstemp[[Key[orientation]]][[3]][[1]]]]; matstemp[[Key[orientation]]][[3]][[2]] = Chop[N[{{Cos[rotatesteptemp*Degree], -Sin[rotatesteptemp*Degree], 0}, {Sin[rotatesteptemp*Degree], Cos[rotatesteptemp*Degree], 0}, {0, 0, 1}} . matstemp[[Key[orientation]]][[3]][[2]]]]; matstemp[[Key[orientation]]][[3]][[3]] = Chop[N[{{Cos[rotatesteptemp*Degree], -Sin[rotatesteptemp*Degree], 0}, {Sin[rotatesteptemp*Degree], Cos[rotatesteptemp*Degree], 0}, {0, 0, 1}} . matstemp[[Key[orientation]]][[3]][[3]]]]; hklConvert[matstemp]; extMater[matstemp]; mats[[i]] = matstemp; ]]; If[assumption == 0, flagJK = False; flagHH = False; {wavLLocal, wavNLLocal} = f4NL[mats, wIncLocal]; , If[assumption == 1, flagBackward = False; flagStandingWave = False; flagJK = True; flagHH = False; {wavLLocal, wavNLLocal} = f4NL[mats, wIncLocal, True]; , If[assumption == 2, flagBackward = False; flagStandingWave = False; flagJK = False; flagHH = True; {wavLLocal, wavNLLocal} = f4NL[mats, wIncLocal, True]; ]; ]; ]; {rmpw1Local, rmpw2Local} = wavNLLocal[[1]]; {tmpw1Local, tmpw2Local} = wavNLLocal[[2]]; extWave[rmpw1Local]; extWave[rmpw2Local]; extWave[tmpw1Local]; extWave[tmpw2Local]; rEboLocal = (rmpw2Local[A] + rmpw1Local[A])[[1 ;; 2]]; rEruiLocal = {{Cos[ψ], -Sin[ψ]}, {Sin[ψ], Cos[ψ]}} . rEboLocal; tEboLocal = (tmpw2Local[A] + tmpw1Local[A])[[1 ;; 2]]; tEruiLocal = {{Cos[ψ], Sin[ψ]}, {-Sin[ψ], Cos[ψ]}} . tEboLocal; {rotatetemp, Re[(rEruiLocal[[1]] /. φ -> φtemp)*Conjugate[rEruiLocal[[1]] /. φ -> φtemp]], Re[(rEruiLocal[[2]] /. φ -> φtemp)*Conjugate[rEruiLocal[[2]] /. φ -> φtemp]], Re[(tEruiLocal[[1]] /. φ -> φtemp)*Conjugate[tEruiLocal[[1]] /. φ -> φtemp]], Re[(tEruiLocal[[2]] /. φ -> φtemp)*Conjugate[tEruiLocal[[2]] /. φ -> φtemp]]}]

solveFresnel.definition:
Attributes[solveFresnel] = {HoldAll}
 
solveFresnel[wIn_List, wR_List, wT_List, unknowns_] := Module[{getH, sol, equ, EMtop, EMbot, HMtop, HMbot, B, M}, getH[wav_] := Cross[Key[k][wav], Key[EE][wav]]/(Key[ω][wav]*μ0); EMtop = Total[(Key[EE][#1] & ) /@ Flatten[{wIn, wR}]]; EMbot = Total[(Key[EE][#1] & ) /@ Flatten[wT]]; HMtop = Total[(getH[#1] & ) /@ Flatten[{wIn, wR}]]; HMbot = Total[(getH[#1] & ) /@ Flatten[wT]]; If[flagLinearSolve, equ = {EMtop[[1]] - EMbot[[1]] == 0, HMtop[[1]] - HMbot[[1]] == 0, EMtop[[2]] - EMbot[[2]] == 0, HMtop[[2]] - HMbot[[2]] == 0}; {B, M} = Normal[CoefficientArrays[equ, unknowns]]; sol = Thread[unknowns -> LinearSolve[M, B]]; , equ = {EMtop[[1 ;; 2]] == EMbot[[1 ;; 2]], HMtop[[1 ;; 2]] == HMbot[[1 ;; 2]]}; equ = Flatten[Simplify[Thread /@ equ]]; Quiet[If[flagNSolve, sol = NSolve[equ, unknowns], sol = Solve[equ, unknowns]]]; If[sol === {}, Print["sol is {} in solveFresnel! "]; sol = Thread[{unknowns -> ConstantArray[0., Length[unknowns]]}], sol = sol[[1]]]; ]; wR = wR /. sol; wT = wT /. sol; ]

solveFresnelN.definition:
Attributes[solveFresnelN] = {HoldAll}
 
solveFresnelN[wAir_, wMed_, wSub_, thickness_, unknowns_] := Module[{sol = {}, i, equ = {}, equE, equH, nM, equTop, equBot, getH, nloop = 0, B, M}, nM = Length[wMed]; getH[wav_] := Cross[Key[k][wav], Key[EE][wav]]/(Key[ω][wav]*μ0); equTop = {Total[Key[EE] /@ wAir][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[Key[EE] /@ wMed[[1]]][[1 ;; 2]], Total[getH /@ wAir][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[getH /@ wMed[[1]]][[1 ;; 2]]}; AppendTo[equ, equTop]; For[i = 1, i < nM, i++, equE = Total[(Exp[I*(#1[k] . {0, 0, 1}*thickness[[i]])]*Key[EE][#1] & ) /@ wMed[[i]]][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[Key[EE] /@ wMed[[i + 1]]][[1 ;; 2]]; equH = Total[(Exp[I*(#1[k] . {0, 0, 1}*thickness[[i]])]*getH[#1] & ) /@ wMed[[i]]][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[getH /@ wMed[[i + 1]]][[1 ;; 2]]; AppendTo[equ, {equE, equH}]]; equBot = {Total[(Exp[I*(#1[k] . {0, 0, 1}*thickness[[nM]])]*Key[EE][#1] & ) /@ wMed[[nM]]][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[Key[EE] /@ wSub][[1 ;; 2]], Total[(Exp[I*(#1[k] . {0, 0, 1}*thickness[[nM]])]*getH[#1] & ) /@ wMed[[nM]]][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[getH /@ wSub][[1 ;; 2]]}; AppendTo[equ, equBot]; equ = Flatten[equ]; equ = Flatten[Thread /@ equ]; If[debug, Print["k of wMed
", (#1[k] & ) /@ wMed[[nM]]]]; If[debug, Print["Here!!! equ
", MatrixForm[Chop[Simplify[Flatten[Thread /@ equ] /. {Δδ -> 0}]]]]]; If[flagLinearSolve, {B, M} = Normal[CoefficientArrays[equ, unknowns]]; sol = Thread[unknowns -> LinearSolve[M, B]]; , Quiet[If[flagNSolve, sol = NSolve[equ, unknowns], sol = Solve[equ, unknowns]]]; If[Length[sol] == 0, Print["sol is {} in solveFresnelN!"]; sol = Thread[unknowns -> ConstantArray[0., Length[unknowns]]], sol = sol[[1]]]; ]; If[debug, Print["sol
", MatrixForm[Simplify[sol]]]]; wAir = wAir /. sol; wSub = wSub /. sol; wMed = wMed /. sol; ]
